comment: The rate law is exponential between the constants at Modulator.cpp:103-104, 0.01Hz to 100Hz, and the xRate law between :106-107, 0.047619 to 21, which is one twenty-first to twenty-one times. The RATE CV is scaled by ten, so at a full attenuverter one volt shifts the rate by ten hertz. With nothing patched at SYNC the SYNC button works as a sample and hold on the oscillator's output rather than as a sync switch.
